requirements: inherit the workflow pull_request, push and workflow_dispatch triggers without a path filter
apply ci-job.fragment.yml verbatim beneath jobs; it checks out github.sha with persist-credentials false and asserts scripts/assert-clean-head.sh before and after
fetch, offline-install and verify the pinned Linux core toolchain before installing the frozen workspace
set SLITHER_REPOSITORY_ROOT=$PWD, SLITHER_CANDIDATE_SHA=$GITHUB_SHA and a fresh /tmp/slither-evidence-$GITHUB_SHA directory
run pnpm security:solidity:prepare-image, then pnpm security:solidity; do not use a pipeline, continue-on-error, job-level if, or permissive step if
upload the evidence directory with if: always(), if-no-files-found: error, retention-days: 14 and name slither-evidence-$GITHUB_SHA-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT
the upload step itself must not continue on error; a skipped job, missing READY, cancellation, timeout or absent artifact is not acceptable evidence
